text:
incident-bot: Automated pager fired: PD INC-2026 - spike in HTTP 5xx rate for inference-gateway (us-west1). 5m 5xx rate = 9.2% (baseline ~0.4%). Affected paths: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Error class: 502/504 from upstream model-proxy. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.example/incidents/INC-2026

pagerduty: PD alert: assignment to oncall-sre. Please acknowledge.

sam: ack - I'm oncall, taking this. Starting triage now.

jess: I'm available to help with scaling and cache warmup if needed.

liam: grabbing lb + routing logs, will check if a rollout or model variant changed weight.

opsbot: autoscaler observed queue depth spike; scaled inference-gateway from 4 -> 12 pods at 04:12:30 UTC.

sam: looking at logs: a spike of upstream 502s around 04:09. Correlates with a canary bump to model-variant v2b in eu->us routing? checking config.

liam: found a partial route push in edge-route config that increased weight to v2b for ~30s. Might be incompatible compiled kernels with that variant. Rolling back weight to v2a now.

jess: applying rollback, also warming KV cache for v2a. Running: `python tooling/warm_kv.py --model v2a --route /v1/generate --concurrency 8`

sam: patched route weight: `kubectl -n prod patch configmap edge-route --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/routes/generate/weight","value":"v2a:100"}]'` -> applied.

opsbot: route weight change observed by control-plane, traffic shifted back to v2a.

liam: confirming upstream errors dropping. 5xx rate trending down from 9.2% -> 1.1% in the last 3m.

jess: cache warmup shows success, prefix hit rate for v2a increased to 73%. Latency for /v1/generate back to baseline ~220ms.

sam: quick customer impact check: SLO error budget burn for last 10m ~0.02% customers affected, some high-traffic tenants saw a few failed requests. Not seeing widespread data loss.

pagerduty: Incident INC-2026 acknowledged by sam. Please remain in thread until stabilized.

liam: action items: 1) investigate canary rollout gating to prevent >10% weight changes without manual sign-off. 2) add compatibility test for kernel/model-variant combos. I'll open a follow-up ticket.

jess: add a regression alert on model-variant 5xx delta > 1% within 10m.

sam: agreed. Leaving a short runbook note: if 5xx spike correlates with model variant push, immediately revert weight -> 100% previous stable variant and warm cache.

opsbot: control-plane logs: no other correlated infra alarms. Marking autopage action as successful.

sam: last check: 5xx rate at 0.6%, latencies stable. I'm going to hand off to next oncall in 15m after monitoring window.

pagerduty: handoff note: sam -> jess in 15m for watch.

jess: watching. ping me if anything flares. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026 status: mitigated. Closing automated page after 30m if stable.
